paper.abstract_en: We investigate DC transport in a top-down construction of thermal QGP-like theories using a holographic $\mathcal{M}$-theoretic background, incorporating quartic curvature corrections. The DC and Hall conductivities are computed from the Dirac-Born-Infeld (DBI) action of the corresponding type-IIA probe $D6$ flavor branes via the reality condition method proposed in arXiv:0708.1994, arXiv:0705.3870. We further analyze pair-production contributions in the presence and absence of an external magnetic field and work out regimes where thermal pair production dominates over charge carrier transport. These findings extend earlier AdS/CFT results to non-conformal, higher-derivative settings relevant to thermal QGP-like theories.

decision.title_zh: 磁化全息 \mathcal{M}-QGP 中的电荷输运
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了使用全息 \mathcal{M} 理论背景，结合四次曲率修正，对热 QGP 类理论的自上而下构造中的 DC 输运。DC 和 Hall 电导率是通过相应类型 IIA 探针 D6 味膜上的 Dirac-Born-Infeld (DBI) 作用量，利用 arXiv:0708.1994、arXiv:0705.3870 中提出的现实条件方法计算的。我们进一步分析了在存在和不存在外部磁场的情况下热对产生的贡献，并找出了热对产生主导电荷载流子输运的参数区间。这些发现将早期的 AdS/CFT 结果扩展到与热 QGP 类理论相关的非共形、高阶导数情形。
